page.notes: The printed text ends mid-word with "per-" at the foot of the page, and continues on the next page. The opening passage is a fragment continuing from the previous page. The line-end at "securi[?]" is doubtful: the word may be securitas, with the end cut off. "Pōtificiis" is written with an abbreviation stroke over the o (printed Pötificiis). The quotation marks in the left margin beside the top lines are not transcribed as text. The right edge shows the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.
